_comment: Where to look for jobs. Edit feeds/searches freely.
_minScoreComment: Keyword pre-gate before the LLM. Since the LLM gate (llm.minScore) does the real screening, this only needs to drop obvious non-matches: at 25 it was rejecting Java/Python SDET postings (17–24 points; the profile weights lean TypeScript/Playwright) that the LLM never got to see. A source may override it with its own minScore. Raise to be pickier, lower for more results.
_candidateCountryComment: Where the candidate lives and works remotely from — every spelling the boards use (English + local). Drives two things: the LLM gate scores a vacancy open only to residents of OTHER countries (or requiring relocation / an office abroad) at most 10, and Djinni's countries segment ('Тільки віддалено · Канада, Польща, Сербія') must name one of these or the whole world. The first entry is used in the English LLM prompt.
_excludeTitleComment: Job titles containing any of these whole words are skipped before scoring (no application package), across all sources. Used to drop entry-level roles, manual-only QA and lead/management roles (the candidate wants hands-on automation, not a team to run). Matched in the title only (Latin words, whole-word), so senior roles that merely mention these words in the description are kept. Note: 'manual' also drops hybrid titles like 'QA Engineer (Manual + Automation)' — deliberate, the LLM gate is the fallback for descriptions; 'lead' drops 'AQA Lead' and 'Lead QA Engineer' alike.
_excludeLocationComment: Boards also list vacancies physically located abroad (DOU marks them 'за кордоном', Djinni 'Тільки офіс · Польща' etc). Jobs whose location contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are dropped across ALL sources before scoring.
_llmComment: LLM re-scoring + tailored cover letters via the local Claude CLI (claude -p). Keyword minScore/requireRole decide what reaches the LLM; when the LLM answers with a fit score below llm.minScore (0–100) the job is dropped as low instead of getting a package. A failed or timed-out verdict defers the job to the next run; a second failure writes a keyword-only package (never lose a match to an outage). Set minScore to 0 to make the LLM advisory-only. maxPerRun caps CLI calls per run. `model` is the claude CLI alias (sonnet by default: stricter on weak fits and ~2x faster than haiku); `concurrency` = parallel CLI calls per run (default 3); `timeoutSec` (default 180, min 30) kills a call that runs longer; the log line `llm: verdict in N s` shows what good calls take.

djinni._comment: Public Djinni jobs board, read with a plain fetch (no login, no browser). Each search is a full jobs-search URL — copy them from your browser's filters. Use primary_keyword=QA+Automation or primary_keyword=QA (Manual) for categories, or all_keywords=TERM for free-text. fullDescription (default true) follows each job link for the complete text so scoring is accurate; set false to score on the listing snippet only. pages (default 3): Djinni does not list newest-first, so each search reads this many pages of 15. concurrency (default 5): parallel detail-page fetches.

himalayas._comment: Himalayas remote-jobs board (https://himalayas.app) via its free public JSON API — no key, no login, no browser. Foreign employers hiring remotely. Each search is a free-text query; the API itself keeps only jobs open to the FIRST candidateCountry entry (use its English name) or to the whole world, newest first. pages (default 2): pages of up to 20 read per search. worldwide (default true): false keeps only jobs that name the candidate's country itself and drops the ones open to the whole world, which draw applicants from everywhere.

tgchannels._comment: Public Telegram job channels, read through their web preview (https://t.me/s/<channel>) — no login, no bot, no browser. Only channels have a preview: a group (members, not subscribers) is reported and skipped. Posts must use the 'Field: value' template @remote_qa_jobs uses (Title, Company name, Location, Anywhere, …); a post without a Title is skipped. Location / Anywhere decide eligibility like Djinni's countries: the candidate's country or the whole world; worldwide (default true): false keeps only posts whose Location names the candidate's country itself. fullDescription (default true) fetches each new job's apply link for the full JSON-LD description — the post's own summary is too short for the LLM gate. pages (default 1): pages of ~20 posts read per channel. Unrelated to telegram.json, which sends your own alerts to your phone.

linkedin._comment: Scraping LinkedIn job search violates ToS and is more detectable. Kept modest: few results, polite delays. Set enabled=false to turn off.
